verdict.rationale: Bruno AI has a first-party test-generation flow: in the Tests tab you click the AI icon, describe what to assert, and review the generated test code before accepting it. It also offers ghost-text suggestions in the Tests editor, chat prompts like "write a test that checks the response time is under 500ms," and agent workflows that build collections with test cases from backend source code. Bruno AI is said to understand the context of the open request, which implies it draws on endpoint context. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that tests are generated from an OpenAPI spec or a captured response body, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the quality of the generated tests.
